_comment: Checked-in expectations for acceptance criterion 7: replaying every fixture
must normalize to these fields. Only the deterministic identity fields are
asserted — Title is model-written prose and is deliberately not pinned.
'observed' records what the live dev run actually produced on 2026-08-09.
Where it differs from 'expect', the disagreement is recorded here rather
than quietly accepted (criterion 7 requires exactly that).
malformed.json intentionally has no row: it must FAIL the run via the

cloudwatch-alarm.json.note: Confirmed in Step 0'; fingerprint was stable across two fires.

alertmanager.json.note: Every field is present verbatim in labels (severity, env, job); no inference needed.

manual.json.note: Payload already carries the target vocabulary; a pass-through case.

note: DISAGREEMENT. The payload contains no environment field at all. The
model inferred Env=prod from head_branch=main. That is a defensible
reading but it is an invention, not an extraction — a CI failure on
main is not inherently a prod alert, and nothing in the payload says
Severity=warning is likewise a judgement call on a failed pipeline.
This is the shape of risk that matters for spec open question 7: the
model does not drift on fields the payload states, it invents fields
the payload omits. Pin Env for CI sources rather than trusting it.
Guard fires, run is Failed, no row created — verified live.
The first attempt failed for the WRONG reason: the prompt said to blank
every field while source/severity/env/state carry enums that exclude
the empty string. The model noticed the contradiction and reasoned
aloud in its output, breaking JSON parsing (TransformBadOutput). The
outcome looked right - no row - but by a fragile path. Fixed by
scoping the blanking instruction to the free-text fields only.
